title: Attack on Monastir
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Attack on Monastir", at revision 1370429514, opens: "The attack on Monastir was an attempt by the Maltese knights of Hospitallers to attack and sack the Tunisian city of Monastir; the attack, however, failed." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q131765078, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1603 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
